products.title: Poppy Seeds
products.description: Oriental poppy seeds for stunning red and orange blooms. Thrives in Kashmir's climate.

growing_instructions: Sow seeds directly into garden soil in autumn from October to November or very early spring in March.
Foliage rosettes establish in cool weather from March to April.
Brilliant crepe-paper petals bloom from May through June, followed by decorative seed pods in July.
Annual plants naturally decline in July heat; collect pods and clear spent stalks.
care_instructions: Water lightly until germination, then only when surface dries.
Avoid heavy nitrogen, which reduces flowering quality.
Stake taller strains in windy sites.
Collect dry seed pods when they turn straw-colored.

symbolism.origin: In classical Greco-Roman mythology, poppies were associated with Demeter, Morpheus, and Hypnos; in literature and folk tradition, poppies symbolize eternal remembrance and peaceful sleep.

products.title: Sunflower Seeds
products.description: Bright sunflower seeds for tall, cheerful blooms. Attracts pollinators and birds.

growing_instructions: Sow seeds directly outdoors in late April or May once spring frost risk has passed.
Rapid stalk growth occurs under long valley summer days from June through July.
Massive golden heads flower from July to September and seeds mature in October.
Remove spent stalks in October before winter freezes begin.
care_instructions: Water deeply every 5-7 days; do not keep soil constantly soggy.
Weed early to reduce competition during rapid stem elongation.
Protect heads from birds as seeds mature.
Harvest when back of flower head turns yellow-brown and seeds harden.

symbolism.origin: In Greek myth, Clytie's eternal gaze toward the sun god Apollo transformed her into a sunflower, cementing its worldwide meaning of loyalty, adoration, and steadfast joy.

products.title: Tulip Bulbs
products.description: Premium Dutch tulip flower bulbs ready for autumn and winter planting. Produces vibrant cup-shaped spring blooms.

meanings: I declare my love for you

growing_instructions: Plant bulbs 15 cm deep in fertile garden beds from October through November before soil freezes.
Chills naturally under snow through Chillai Kalan (December-January) for essential dormancy.
World-famous Srinagar tulip bloom occurs from late March through April.
Allow foliage to turn yellow and die back naturally in June to recharge bulbs; lift or leave dormant.
care_instructions: Water thoroughly once upon planting, then rely on winter moisture until spring sprout.
Avoid saturated, clayey beds that induce fungal bulb rot (Botrytis).
Allow foliage to turn completely yellow before cutting back so bulbs replenish energy for next season.

products.title: Daffodil Bulbs
products.description: High-grade narcissus bulbs producing cheerful trumpet-shaped golden-yellow spring blooms. Naturalizes easily.

symbolism.origin: From the myth of Narcissus falling in love with his reflection.

growing_instructions: Plant bulbs pointed-end up in well-drained soil in October and November.
Endures freezing winter cold unharmed underground from December to February.
Cheerful yellow and white trumpets bloom among the earliest spring flowers in March and April.
Foliage withers naturally by late June; naturalizes and returns every spring.
care_instructions: Keep soil evenly moist during active growth and blooming flush.
Do not tie or cut green foliage; let leaves photosynthesize for at least 6 weeks post-bloom.
Top-dress with composted leaf mold or bone meal in autumn.

products.title: Hyacinth Bulbs
products.description: Prized spring-blooming bulbs renowned for their dense flower spikes and intoxicating sweet fragrance.

symbolism.origin: From Apollo’s grief over Hyacinthus in Greek myth.

growing_instructions: Plant bulbs outdoors in October-November or force in glass jars indoors in November.
Requires winter ground chill through December and January to trigger flower spikes.
Intensely fragrant dense flower spikes bloom in April.
Cut spent bloom spikes in May, allowing foliage to nourish the bulb until dormant in June.
care_instructions: Water moderately in spring dry spells until flowers fade.
Stake dense, heavy bloom spikes in windy mountain locations.
Let leaves wither completely to yellow before removing.

products.title: Gladiolus Corms
products.description: Summer-flowering sword lily corms producing dramatic, tall spikes of colorful blossoms.

growing_instructions: Plant corms 10-12 cm deep in full sun from mid-April through May after last spring frost.
Tall sword-like foliage and flower spikes shoot up from June through July.
Vibrant tiered flower spikes bloom continuously from July through September.
Dig up corms in late October before severe soil freezes, dry thoroughly, and store frost-free until spring.
care_instructions: Water deeply once weekly, increasing moisture as flower spikes emerge.
Support tall flower spikes with bamboo stakes to prevent toppling.
Lift corms before winter freezes, dry in shaded airy spot, and store cool and dry.

products.title: Asiatic Lily Bulbs
products.description: Stately perennial lily bulbs producing majestic, large trumpet flowers. Return reliably year after year.

symbolism.origin: Associated with the Virgin Mary in Christian art.

growing_instructions: Plant bulbs 15 cm deep in humus-rich, well-draining soil in October-November or March.
Stems emerge strongly in April and bud out across May.
Magnificent upright blooms open in June and July.
Stems die back naturally in autumn; bulbs overwinter safely in frozen ground from November to February.
care_instructions: Maintain consistent root moisture; do not let bulb base dry out completely.
Mulch heavily with pine needle or organic compost in autumn.
Deadhead spent blooms immediately to divert nutrients to bulb scales.
